scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/core clean && bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/core build:types && bun run --cwd packages/agents clean && bun run --cwd packages/agents build && bun run --cwd packages/cli clean && bun run --cwd packages/cli build && bun run --cwd packages/cli build:types
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/core test && bun run --cwd packages/server test && bun run --cwd packages/agents test && bun run --cwd packages/cli test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/core typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/server typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/agents typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/cli typecheck
scripts.coverage:check: bun run --cwd packages/core test --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-dir=../../coverage/core && bun run --cwd packages/server test --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-dir=../../coverage/server && bun run --cwd packages/agents test --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-dir=../../coverage/agents && bun run --cwd packages/cli test --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-dir=../../coverage/cli && bun run scripts/check-coverage.mjs
scripts.pack:check: bun run --cwd packages/core pack:check && bun run --cwd packages/cli pack:check
scripts.ship:check: bun run ci && bun run pack:check
scripts.ci: bun run format:check && bun run lint:check && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test && bun run coverage:check
scripts.release:disabled: echo 'npm publishing disabled until the package scope decision is finalized'
